{"metadata":{"description":"Make every agent edit approvable in DeepSeek Harness: full-diff review, per-file / per-block keep & revert, undo/redo.","id":"gh:1335980444","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-diff-approval","slug":"9087/dsh-diff-approval","topics":["ai-coding","approval","deepseek-harness","diff","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Make every agent edit approvable in DeepSeek Harness: full-diff review, per-file / per-block keep & "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dit approvable in DeepSeek Harness: full-diff review, per-file / per-block keep & revert, undo/redo."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-diff-approval"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":")"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for pending-change review: it automatically tracks every successful "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"`edit`, `write`, and editor (`str_replace_editor`) mutation, folds them into a single pending list i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"n the sidebar where each file's diff can be reviewed and kept/reverted — and it can also import the "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"workspace's version-control repository's local changes (Git / SVN / Perforce) in one click."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The panel also collapses its review sidebar into a floating card; while floating, each of its four e"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"dges — the left sidebar, the header above, the right sidebar, the composer below — can be chosen to "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"be covered (all four is what used to be fullscreen, and covering nothing is a plain floating card)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Two entries open it: the row at the sidebar foot, and a button in the Session header's right-hand co"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ntrols — the cluster the app keeps its own per-session actions in (where "Download session log" live"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"s) — so the review stays one click away with the sidebar collapsed or hidden."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The panel can also dock as a tab in the app's right sidebar:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Diff view**: syntax-highlighted whole-file diff with +/− counts, an overview ruler on the scroll"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"bar showing where changes sit, and an in-file search (`Ctrl+F`, step with `F3` / `Shift+F3`) that hi"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ghlights matched words. Rows are virtualized, so huge files stay smooth. The line-number column keep"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"s a surface of its own — a shade lighter than the code block, so the numbers read as a column rather"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" than as part of the code — and stays pinned while the code scrolls sideways.
- **Block navigation &"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" decisions**: jump between change blocks with `Ctrl+↑/↓` (or the previous/next buttons) — the focuse"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"d block flashes, navigation is anchored to the scroll position and wraps at the top/bottom. Hover a "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"block to **Keep** or **Revert** just that block from a small actions frame that also shows its posit"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ion (e.g. "2/5"); after a single-block decision, focus advances to the next block. The lead rows lef"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"t above the jumped-to block are configurable in settings.
- **Selection frame**: drag to select a ra"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"nge of lines and a frame appears to **Keep** / **Revert** exactly that range.
- **Per-file and bulk "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"decisions**: the files in the review sidebar can be kept / reverted one at a time, or **Keep all** /"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" **Revert all** from its footer.
- **Resolved files stay listed**: once every change in a file has b"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"een kept/reverted, the entry remains in the list and the panel asks whether to remove it or keep it "},{"id":"p10s15","text":"there.
- **Undo / Redo**: every keep, revert, import, and comment is undoable with `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"Shift+Z` (rebindable in Shortcuts; `Ctrl+Y` remains an alias), active while the panel is open — text"},{"id":"p10s17","text":" inputs keep their own editing.
- **Quick summon & file cycling**: `Ctrl+D` (configurable in setting"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"s) toggles the review panel from anywhere and `Esc` closes it; the panel is also one click away from"},{"id":"p10s19","text":" the sidebar-foot row and from a button in the Session header beside the app's own controls; `Ctrl+T"},{"id":"p10s20","text":"ab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` cycle through the pending files.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 📦 Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"If `dsh` is on your `PATH`:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Or, if you run the harness through npx (e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"or manually: add the package to your profile's `package.json` dependencies and insert this row into "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 🚀 Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Work with the agent as usual — successful `edit` / `write` / editor (`str_replace_editor`) calls "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"are recorded automatically.
2. Click the **Pending changes** action at the sidebar footer, review ea"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ch file's diff, and **Keep** / **Revert**.
3. When the list is empty, **Import version-control chang"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"es** pulls in what the workspace has not committed yet."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 📝 Notes"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Only tracked mutations (`edit`, `write`, and `str_replace_editor` editor calls) are recorded autom"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"atically. Deletions made outside these tools (e.g. shell `rm`) are sensed only for tracked files: th"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e entry turns "File is gone" and its Revert restores the file.
- The VCS import runs read-only Git/S"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"VN/Perforce commands through the deployment's shell executor, so the respective CLI must be on `PATH"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"`. Including files version control has not seen (default off) scans the whole workspace, which can b"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"e slow on large trees.
- For a newly-created file, the whole-file revert action reads **Delete** and"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" removes the file.
- Reverting a file writes it back with its current line endings (LF / CRLF) prese"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"rved.
- Sessions with no workspace keep their entries memory-only; corrupt persistence files are rej"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ected and can be deleted to reset.
- The sidebar footer entry stacks vertically with other plugins' "},{"id":"p22s10","text":"footer actions and defers to the dedicated `dsh-footer-order` plugin when it is present."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## 🛠 Development"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Development setup, the command list, the two halves' reload rules and the font pipeline: `DEVELOP.md"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"velopment setup, the command list, the two halves' reload rules and the font pipeline: `DEVELOP.md`."}],"truncated":true}
